weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
If unit initiates combat or if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat. If unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+7, but after combat, if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit.

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Spd through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Atk+Spd total through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Spd-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Atk+Spd total through its next action.

c.d: Inflicts Spd/Def-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
